messages:
Sam: FYI got another request from Acme asking for per-tenant metrics in the API — they want tag-level usage breakdown for cost allocation. Sounds very similar to ticket #1723.
Elaine: Thanks — can you paste their exact wording?
Omar: Quote from the customer: \"we need billing-grade per-tenant usage metrics (daily/weekly), with tag filters and export to CSV/BigQuery\". Earlier ticket was about \"usage breakdown for cost allocation\" but not explicit about export.
Sam: My read: overlap but slightly different acceptance criteria (export + retention). I think it's a duplicate of backlog item 589 (usage telemetry epic) but needs clarifying ACs.
Elaine: Agreed to merge as duplicate into 589, but we need a short spec to capture the export+retention ask before closing. Can we get SLO/format requirements?
Julia: Acme is on trial and asked if this could be expedited. Sales asked for an ETA to share with customer.
Elaine: Recommend labeling as P2 for prioritization. Tentative plan: groom this week, put on next planning board if eng estimate <= 2 sprint-points. Otherwise defer and communicate timeline.
Sam: I'll add links & context to the customer ticket and mark as dupe. Proposed labels: `dupe-of-589`, `cust:acme`, `area:telemetry`, `priority:P2`.
Omar: Support update draft: \"We're merging your request into an existing roadmap item (589) so we don't fragment work. PM will follow up with clarifying questions and an ETA.\" Want me to send now or after PM writes spec?
Elaine: Send after I post the spec stub (so we avoid re-opening). I'll write a short spec by Thu: acceptance criteria (1) daily+weekly aggregates, (2) tag filters, (3) CSV export + BigQuery export link, (4) retention 90/365 rules, (5) latency target <100ms for single-tenant queries.
Sam: Noted. Eng to estimate by Fri. If estimate <= 2 sprints we target a canary for dedicated customers in sprint+2.
Julia: If we can promise a rough ETA this week that helps sales. If not, say "under review".
support-bot: ticket #2345 updated — linked to backlog item #589 (triggered by Sam).
Omar: I'll update the customer thread with the merge note and tentative timing tomorrow morning, and tag sales.
Elaine: Action list: PM (Elaine) - spec stub by Thu; Eng (TBD) - estimate by Fri; Support (Omar) - customer update; Sales (Julia) - manage expectations. We'll close #2345 as duplicate after merging notes. :thumbsup:
Sam: Added grooming checklist to 589: sample payloads, example queries, data retention options, cost estimate delta.
Elaine: Also add eval/launch criteria: sample dataset run, QA on export formats, small-scale pilot with Acme. If any blocker appears (privacy or KMS needs), escalate to security.
Julia: Thanks — I'll flag this on Acme deal thread so CSMs don't promise dates.
Sam: Closing loop here. Reactions: :merge: if everyone agrees to merge and label.
Elaine: Merge and proceed. We'll update the thread once the spec is live
